requirements.statement: A success definition can declare, up front, an off-host proof for a must-pass criterion: a named CI job (workflow file and job name). The declaration is read deterministically from the definition; on a row that is not must-pass it is ignored and reported, never acted on. (Declared in the TRD Objectives table per D1; reaches criteria via the definition's Must pass cell.)
requirements.source: TRD Objectives, O1 (Investigation O1, Must pass: yes)

requirements.statement: When a must-pass criterion with a declared off-host proof is triaged not-checkable-here, the loop checks that job's conclusion for the run's commit (gh run list / gh run view). A green job settles the criterion met, citing the CI run id and URL as evidence; a red, cancelled, still-running or absent job leaves it unproven, and the run ends must-pass-unproven as today.
requirements.source: TRD Objectives, O2 (Investigation O2, Must pass: yes)

requirements.statement: The loop never accepts a gap by itself and never invents a proving environment at run time: a must-pass not-checkable criterion with no declared off-host proof still ends the run must-pass-unproven, and a must-pass criterion of kind build-defect or evidence-gap is never settled by an off-host proof, whatever CI says.
requirements.source: TRD Objectives, O3 (Investigation O3, Must pass: yes)

requirements.statement: /refine-verification --auto may not add or change an off-host proof on a must-pass criterion; only an interactive refinement with the owner, or the TRD author at plan time, may declare one. D16 of docs/TRD/verification-must-pass.md stands and is pinned by refine-verification-must-pass.test.js.
requirements.source: TRD Objectives, O4 (Investigation O4, Must pass: yes; citation corrected in v1.1.0)

requirements.statement: Custody (packages/core/lib/custody.js) treats a CI-proven criterion like any other met criterion: it is re-proved when its covered files change and its proof is reused when they do not.
requirements.source: TRD Objectives, O5 (Investigation O5; Must pass: no)

requirements.statement: The verification report and /ship-build's readout name each criterion proven off-host and by which CI run.
requirements.source: TRD Objectives, O6 (Investigation O6; Must pass: no)

requirements.statement: A headless fixture run (the fixtures environment in verification.md) with one host-only must-pass criterion and a stubbed CI result shows the criterion settled met with the run id cited.
requirements.source: TRD Objectives, O7 (Investigation O7, Must pass: yes)

requirements.statement: Every git and gh call the off-host lookup makes passes its arguments as an array to spawnSync, never through a shell: the workflow file and job name come from a file a model helped write.
requirements.source: TRD Objectives, O8 (CLAUDE.md Security Considerations; domain-derived; Must pass: no)

requirements.statement: A TRD with no Off-host proof column, and so a run with no declared off-host proof, behaves exactly as today, and a report with no off-host-proven criterion renders byte-identically to today's.
requirements.source: TRD Objectives, O9 (Investigation Intended Change items 1 and 6, re-targeted to the TRD column by D1; Must pass: no)

requirements.statement: Every edited packaged runtime file under packages/core/ has its .claude/ mirror updated to be byte-identical.
requirements.source: TRD Objectives, O10 (constitution.md Architecture Invariants, Vendored Runtime; Must pass: no)

requirements.statement: Tests pass with unit coverage of the changed code at or above 60% and integration coverage at or above 50%, where applicable.
requirements.source: TRD Objectives, O11 (constitution.md Quality Gates; TRD 6.1; Must pass: no)

requirements.statement: Documentation describing the changed behaviour is updated in the same change.
requirements.source: TRD Objectives, O12 (constitution.md Quality Gates; Must pass: no)
